title: Lifting computation through an alphabet embedding
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type with decidable equality, let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, and let $e$ be an injection from the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$. If $M$ computes a function $f$ on Boolean words in time $T$, then the machine obtained by lifting its symbols along $e$ computes $f$ via $e$ in time $T$: on every Boolean word $x$ encoded letterwise by $e$, it halts within $T(|x|)$ steps and outputs the letterwise $e$-image of $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Boolean Turing machine
e is an injection from Booleans to Gamma
f maps Boolean words to Boolean words
T maps natural numbers to natural numbers
M computes f in time T
